answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The quartz lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the dune is where a second reviewer recomputes them. By the falcon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
